attribution.note: Zitron states and endorses the numerical comparison in his own words.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the numerical observation and relative scale without adopting the surrounding allegation of distraction.

contract.note: Using the latest reported quarter, company-reported ARR and its arithmetic monthly equivalent is a fair, ordinary reading of the statement.

evidence.note: The timely company disclosure reports $800 million Agentforce ARR and $11.2 billion quarterly revenue. ARR divided by twelve is approximately $66.7 million; this is not realized monthly revenue.

The earnings-call transcript supports the explicitly claimed consolidated quarterly revenue comparator. Its different metric does not make it mere context for that component. It remains a company disclosure.

reviews.rationale: The matched disclosures report $800 million Agentforce ARR and $11.2 billion Salesforce quarterly revenue. The annualized monthly equivalent is approximately $66.7 million. These support the numerical comparison under the fair contract; they are company disclosures, not independent findings.
